title: symphyotrichum cordifolium var. polycephalum
intro: Symphyotrichum cordifolium var. polycephalum, commonly known as the broadleaf ironweed, is a plant species that belongs to the sunflower family. The broadleaf ironweed has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Symphyotrichum cordifolium var. polycephalum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
